Definition: from a presumed derivative of G2060 (as the god of language); to translate:--interpret.
BiblicalUsage: I take hermēneúō to mean interpret, nothing more and nothing less. It occurs 3 times, and John and Hebrews show it doing ordinary work in ordinary sentences. The Bible uses plain words plainly, and this is one of them.
TheologicalSignificance: hermēneúō matters to me because interpretation is a gift, and it exists so the church can understand what God is saying. My position is that Scripture does not hide its meaning from honest readers.
RelatedEvents: The Calling of the First Disciples; The Healing of the Man Born Blind
